text: The single-node delay-feedback reservoir is functionally equivalent to which reservoir topology?
choices: A fully random, all-to-all connected ESN
A ring reservoir with cyclic nearest-neighbor coupling (node i driven by node i−1)
explanation: In the discrete-map limit, virtual node i is driven by node i−1 (and node 0 by node N−1 of the previous step via the delay), i.e. a ring / cyclic-coupling reservoir (Rodan & Tino). The delay line physically realizes the ring's recurrent connection. It is NOT dense all-to-all (option 0), not feedforward (option 1), and not a symmetric-weight Hopfield net (option 3).
